item.title: What Creativity Is And How To Stimulate It?
item.description: There are so many definitions of creativity given in literature that it’s hard to pinpoint a single definition and say, “This is it!” Torrance (1962) defines creativity as the process of sensing gaps or missing elements and forming ideas or hypotheses concerning them. This means that if you’re creative, you can see where something doesn’t…
